label: Remote support & research
heading: I keep the moving parts from becoming messy.
description: Useful for founders, creators, and small teams who need a dependable extra pair of hands—not another layer of management.

items.title: Research
items.description: Find, compare, verify, and summarize online information with source links and clear takeaways.

items.title: Organize
items.description: Clean spreadsheets, files, raw assets, schedules, and shared workspaces using a consistent system.

items.title: Publish & check
items.description: Prepare uploads, captions, formatting, links, and final quality checks before content goes live.

items.title: Document & report
items.description: Turn repeated work into checklists or SOPs, then send concise progress updates and next steps.

tools: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Notion, Trello, Slack, Teams, Canva, and Adobe Creative Cloud.
approach: I can study a new workflow, document what I learn, ask focused questions, and keep the work visible. For unfamiliar tasks, I confirm the expected output before starting.
